misogynistic_lighting.lighting.tooltip: One grey light as before the coloured lighting: no orange torchlight, no flicker, darker nights.
misogynistic_lighting.colours.tooltip: 1.7.10's sky, fog, sunrise and cloud colours, and the Nether's old red fog.
misogynistic_lighting.fog.tooltip: The world fades from a quarter of the render distance out, as in alpha and beta.
misogynistic_lighting.void_fog.tooltip: Near the bottom of the Overworld, where no sky light reaches, the fog closes in and turns black.
misogynistic_lighting.version.tooltip: The old version text in the top left of the screen. What it says is set in nostalgic.cfg.
misogynistic_lighting.item_name.tooltip: The item's name when you pick another slot, which the old game never showed.
misogynistic_lighting.xp_bar.tooltip: The old game had none; enchanting needs it. A horse's jump bar stays either way.
